title: Wasted Loops
paragraphs: “Mr. Motoyasu, I don’t think this is the right person.”
“No, I’m sure of it. That is Éclair!”
“It’s Motoyasu we’re talking about. If he’s calling Naofumi ‘Father,’ there’s got to be a reason for it.”
Ren had caught on. I felt like an unusual bond of trust had been formed between us. Father glanced at me with a troubled expression before turning back to Éclair.
“Then, can you tell us your name?”
“Me? My name is Eclair. Eclair Seaetto.”
“It’s not too different. In our world, there’s a word with the same meaning.”
“Is that so?”
“I think it was in French? The pastry ‘Éclair’ is actually called ‘Éclair’ in full.”
“I see… Mr. Naofumi, are you knowledgeable about foreign languages?”
“I just remembered it because I once looked it up while watching anime about how ‘thunder’ is pronounced in other languages.”

Father casually added that explanation. That was helpful. His approach to learning was always something to take note of. After all, he had taught himself this world’s language in a short amount of time.
“Just to confirm… why are you imprisoned here?”
“Me? I was captured for punishing the soldiers of my own country who hunted demi-humans. My status as a knight has been stripped as well.”
Father and the others exchanged glances before turning to me. Father, in particular, looked extremely shocked.
“It looks like you were right, but Motoyasu… how do you know all this? And why did Ren and Itsuki believe I didn’t do it?”
“Oh, that’s because Motoyasu showed us a vision of that woman stripping you of all your belongings while you were asleep.”
“Wha—”

Father opened and closed his mouth several times in stunned silence. I had been watching quietly from the attic back then. Now that I think about it, that was pretty creepy of me, wasn’t it? Well, the one who came up with that plan in the previous loop was Father himself, so it wasn’t really an issue.
“Yeah, and after that, the princess came to hand over the chainmail to Motoyasu, and when he refused, she came to me and told me to accept it instead, as if she knew the future.”
“Then she even warned us that Naofumi would be falsely accused of assault. We even checked with the weapons shop and confirmed that the chainmail was actually his.”
“But why does Motoyasu… know all this?”
“Motoyasu is from the future. He even told you when he defended you—he came to save you from the future.”
“Now that you mention it…”
“That’s why he’s unnaturally strong and knows what’s going to happen.”
“Then why didn’t he warn me when I was about to be robbed, or at the very start?”
Father always asks that question, no matter the world. No doubt about it—he’s still Father, through and through.
“Apparently, he’s looped through this multiple times. Motoyasu, you must’ve tested things out, right?”

“That’s right. When I revealed the truth right after being summoned, the country claimed they would send the Shield Hero to Siltvelt, a country that worships him… but in reality, they tried to assassinate him. I fell into their trap and was nearly killed.”
“So… you looped back after that?”
“Fortunately, I saved him that time, but they still relentlessly pursued Father.”
I gave a brief explanation. That was what had happened in the previous loop. I explained the events leading up to my arrival in Siltvelt.
“I did manage to reach Siltvelt, but then Melromarc launched an all-out war against them. It was quite the ordeal.”
“I see…”
“Until he experienced betrayal firsthand, Father wouldn’t have believed me if I had told him about the future. That’s why I waited for the right moment to help him.”
“Well… yeah, I wouldn’t have had any reason to believe you otherwise. Alright, I get it.”
“Should I mention that Itsuki was killed in this loop?”
Well, I’ll explain it later.
“I don’t really understand what you’re talking about… Who are you people?”
“Would it be best to say that we are the Four Holy Heroes who were summoned the day before yesterday?”
“What!? Why are the Four Holy Heroes here!?”
Éclair rattled her chains and tried to step forward in excitement. It was a scene I had witnessed in the previous loop.
“Explain in detail!”

We explained the situation to Éclair. First, we introduced ourselves. Then, we told her how we were summoned to this world to fight against the Waves and set out with our companions—only for Trash and the Crimson Swine to frame Father and try to sow discord among the heroes. Éclair listened with a serious expression.
“So basically, thanks to Motoyasu, we exposed the kingdom’s conspiracy and ended up here.”
“In other words, Kitamura-dono retained memories of future events, grew stronger, and all the heroes united to save Iwatani-dono, the Shield Hero, from this country’s plot?”
“That’s right.”
“What happened after that? I can’t imagine the king and his people would just let that slide…”
“Once they realized they couldn’t deceive us, they tried to wipe us all out. We turned the tables on them and now we’re here.”
Ren answered Éclair’s question. Her expression grew complicated.
“Turned the tables… don’t tell me—”
“Yeah…”
Itsuki and Father both nodded. Éclair’s legs gave out, and she nearly collapsed.
“The king perished… I suppose he brought it upon himself. What about the Queen?”
“The Queen hasn’t returned yet. Based on my knowledge from previous loops, it will take her about two or three months to get back.”
“I see… If the Wise and Prudent King was killed, then the Queen…” Éclair muttered in shock.
“Do you think the Queen will still protect someone who caused this kind of catastrophe?”
Oh? She went silent. Well, in reality, the rampaging Trash had already been all but abandoned. The only time he had ever been remotely useful was in the first world.
“Haha, I must have lost my mind… To think I almost believed such nonsense.”
“Ah, looks like she thinks we’re lying.”
“We are not lying, I say.”
“Well, just from hearing the story, it’s hard to believe.”
“At first, I also thought you guys were trying to deceive me on a grand scale, but thanks to Motoyasu’s massacre, I realized it wasn’t a lie.”
“Yeah, if after all that it turned out to be fake, well…”
“It would be more believable if Motoyasu-kun was actually the mastermind and was just using us as his pawns.”
Oh? Father and the others went silent. That’s not true. I would never do such a thing. As I thought that, Father and the others finally spoke up.
“No way… Even though we haven’t known him for long, he just doesn’t seem like that kind of person.”
“Naofumi, that’s an accurate assessment. He’s probably failed so many loops because, like just now, he’s always tried to solve everything by force.”
“Even the method he used to gain our trust was a plan that the previous Naofumi came up with.”
“What a waste of a loop…”
“Why is it even Motoyasu who’s looping, anyway…?”
“Yeah, I feel like there’s gotta be someone more suitable for the job…”
Oh, Father and the others are growing closer. Looks like what I was asked to do last time is actually coming to fruition. That makes me happy.
“Anyway, I was entrusted with a mission by Father and the Queen in the last loop. They said Éclair is necessary for forming alliances.”
I swiftly sliced through the bars of the prison cell with my spear, then cut the chains binding Éclair. Now freed, she remained motionless.
“I must be dreaming… After all that nonsense, now I’m suddenly being freed…”
“Are you still saying such things?”
How troublesome. For now, I’ll just hoist Éclair up with the shaft of my spear.
“If you look outside, you’ll understand, won’t you?”
“Guh… Let me go!”
Éclair struggled, but I dragged her along anyway. Father and the others followed me, looking somewhat troubled. Soon, we exited the prison, and I showed her the outside world.

The area was still in chaos. The soldiers who saw us trembled in fear and fled. Then, from a vantage point in the courtyard, I made sure Éclair got a good look at the church that had been burned to the ground.
“T-This is…!?”
“Now then, Éclair, join my party. You too, Father.”
“Ah, yeah, sure.”
“What are you planning!?”
“Staying here means assassins could come for us at any moment, so we’ll use a skill to teleport out of here.”
“What kind of ridiculous nonsense is that…?”
Dragging along a struggling Éclair was a hassle, but a promise is a promise. No matter what, she’s coming with us.
“If you think this is a dream, just nod for now. We’ll do our best to ensure this doesn’t turn into a bad outcome.”
Thanks to Itsuki’s subtle whispering, it seems Éclair reluctantly agreed to join us.
“Alright, we’re teleporting! Portal Spear!”
And with that, I activated my portal, and whether or not they were already lurking, we completely lost the assassins from the Three Heroes Church.
